description: The negative control for props_corpus (tests/props_corpus.cpp): cases in props/doors.json's shape whose expectations are DELIBERATELY WRONG. props_corpus_negative passes only when the runner reports every one as differing and the run as failed. One case, through props.doors.step as a door session.
sources: hand-written; each case is core's (conformance/props/doors.json) with one expected value changed, named by its new name

contract.doorPoint: door (the layout's measured point) when given, else position + (sin r, cos r) * depth / 2; numbers rounded to 1e-9
contract.facing: the door's outward yaw f (it faces world (sin f, cos f), like rotation): doorYaw when a finite number (from building-fit: pi/2 - doorHeading, whose heading points along (cos h, sin h)); else, when door is given, the footprint face nearest it; else r. Nearest face: along = dx sin r + dz cos r, across = dx cos r - dz sin r (d = door - position); halfAlong = depth / 2, halfAcross = width / 2 (a missing or non-positive one takes the other, both missing 1); |across| / halfAcross > |along| / halfAlong picks right (across > 0, r + pi/2) or left (r - pi/2), else back (along < 0, r + pi) or front (r)
contract.outside: doorPoint + (sin f, cos f) * standoffM, yaw f (rounded to 1e-9): the player stands outside the door's own face, facing out through it
contract.state: no interior stated (null or absent) -> no_interior; else locked when the host says so; else closed
contract.label: name, else businessType, else spec.buildingRole, else Building (first non-empty)
contract.prompt: inside: exit for the building the player is in (null if unlisted); outside: the nearest door not no_interior with ground-plane distance strictly < promptRadiusM, the first listed on a tie
contract.enter: refusals in order: missing_field building, already_inside, unknown_building, no_interior, locked (without keyItemId held); else enter_interior {building, interior: interior:<id>, interiorFunction, arrive: the first entrance door's position (interior frame) or null when none is listed, entrance, unlocked}
contract.exit: not_inside, unknown_building; else exit_to_exterior {building, arrive: outside, yaw}

cases.name: session: expected WRONGLY to enter a locked door without its key
